reported_results.text: The empty area remaining at each time point was quantified using NIH image analysis software (version 1.62), and compared to that of the 0-h time point (H).
The percentage of inhibition was ~70% in cells subjected to H/R, compared to only ~30% in cells under normoxia (Figure 1H).
Cell migration was increased 1.7-fold under H/R conditions relative to normoxic conditions (Supplementary Figure 2A and 2B).
